Name: Better Wizard Portraits (Seasonal Outfits and SVE compatible)
Author: Iggyims
Description:
[size=5]THIS IS NOT A MOD!!! Just image files!

[/size][size=3]You will need to download the[size=3] [/size][/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE[/url] [size=3]mod and replace the images for Magnus to get these portraits.[/size][size=5]
[/size][size=5]
[/size][size=4]INSTALLATION:
[/size][list=1]
[*]Download this mod manually and unzip
[*]Open the folder that says "Better Wizard Seasonal SVE"
[*]There should be two folders, one that says "character" and one that says "portrait"
[*]Copy the images from "character" and paste them into the Magnus folder under "Characters" in the Seasonal Outfits mod
[*]Overwrite all changes (Make sure the old images are replaced with the new ones) 
[*]Copy the images from "portrait" and paste them into the Magnus folder under "Portraits" in the Seasonal Outfits mod
[*]Overwrite all changes (again, making sure the old images are replaced with the new ones)
[*]Run the game like normal
[/list]
[size=4]CREDITS:
[/size]
[size=3]I made this mod as an extension to the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37084]Better Wizard for Seasonal Outfits[/url]﻿ mod by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/rachelkel04]rachelkel04[/url], who created the portraits and sprites that I modified to work with SVE (Adding more expressions & sprites for the flower dance).

The original mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE[/url] was created by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Poltergeister]Poltergeister[/url]﻿.
[/size]
